contentText: Russian strikes hit two major bridges in Kyiv late Monday, part of an overnight attack that damaged critical infrastructure and disrupted heating and water in parts of the capital, its mayor said. Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky had warned of an attack by Russia in the coming days even as negotiators representing Kyiv as well as Europe and the United States held talks on future negotiations with Russia aimed at finding a path to end the war. Follow our liveblog for all the latest.
